text:
tess-pm: AP's AP team refused payment for INV-24-0921 due to an unexpected `edge_routing_surcharge` under Dedicated. Not in our order form. @vendors-billing any background?

vendors-billing: Hi Tess, we started itemizing an edge routing surcharge for failover/region hops last quarter. We communicated it in a vendor bulletin but looks like not everyone received it.

neal-ops: We saw a brief 2.5hr failover on 2024-09-01 while us-east scaled. That was an incident window recorded by Redwood monitoring. If this fee is applied during incident-driven failover that's a problem.

contract-legal: Our signed SOW only references reserved commit and burst. No separate surcharge. If vendor is adding billing rules, we need an amendment and customer opt-in.

vendors-billing: Agree that contract changes require amendment. We should not bill without customer acknowledgment. We can either void the charge now or provide detailed per-request CSV and a 30-day credit while we sort documentation.

lia-accounting: I've put INV-24-0921 on hold (code: vendor_dispute). AP will not release payment until vendor confirms credit or justification.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-24-0921 status changed to ON_HOLD by lia-accounting at 2024-09-05T09:03:00Z.

sam-finance: For reconciliation we need the exact trigger rule and the measured metric. Please share the threshold and per-hour values so we can reconcile with our telemetry.

vendors-billing: Rule: surcharge applies when cross-region routed qps > 8% sustained for >1h. For this window 2024-09-01T02:45Z-2024-09-01T05:15Z we recorded 9.3% cross-region routing; surcharge calculated $30/hr = $75.

neal-ops: That timeframe included a provider autoscaler cold start. We have an incident ticket INC-824 that attributes routing to provider recovery, which per SLA should be handled with credits, not a new surcharge.

vendors-billing: Ok, here's a proposal: we will issue a one-time credit for $75 and mark the invoice updated, plus attach a short notice of the policy and provide a contract addendum draft. Is that acceptable?

contract-legal: We will review the addendum before approval. For this invoice we accept the one-time credit, but we need written confirmation that these surcharges will not be applied retroactively to committed accounts without signed amendment.

vendors-billing: Understood. We'll post credit memo CM-2024-0942 for $75 and include a statement that charges prior to customer opt-in will be reversed. We'll also send the addendum for legal review.

lia-accounting: Once CM-2024-0942 is posted we'll clear ON_HOLD and schedule payment.

sam-finance: Filed internal ticket FIN-512 to coordinate with product on whether this surcharge should be productized and how it maps to SLA credit rules.

tess-pm: Thanks everyone. Please tag me when addendum is ready so PM can notify affected accounts. :email:

vendors-billing: Credit posted CM-2024-0942. We'll follow up with addendum draft within 48h and mark this thread closed when AP confirms payment release.

lia-accounting: Noted, tracking CM-2024-0942 and monitoring for application.
